from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date


@dataclass
class Address:
    name: str
    line1: str
    city: str
    postcode: str
    country: str                   # ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. "US", "GB"
    line2: str = ""
    region: str = ""               # state / county


@dataclass
class Customer:
    id: str
    email: str
    name: str
    addresses: list[Address] = field(default_factory=list)
    marketing_opt_in: bool = False
    tier: str = "standard"         # standard | silver | gold
    joined: date | None = None
    tags: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)

    @property
    def default_address(self) -> Address | None:
        return self.addresses[0] if self.addresses else None

    @property
    def first_name(self) -> str:
        return self.name.split()[0] if self.name.strip() else ""

from datetime import date

import pytest

from shopkit.shipping.carriers import estimated_delivery, tracking_link
from shopkit.shipping.packaging import BOXES, chargeable_weight_g, dims_weight_g, format_weight, pick_box
from shopkit.shipping.rates import TooHeavy, shipping_cents
from shopkit.shipping.zones import DOMESTIC, EU, REST_OF_WORLD, zone_for_country


def test_zones():
    assert zone_for_country("us") == DOMESTIC
    assert zone_for_country("DE") == EU
    assert zone_for_country("JP") == REST_OF_WORLD
    assert zone_for_country("US", home="GB") == "north_america"


def test_dims_weight_rounds_up():
    assert dims_weight_g(20, 15, 10) == 600
    assert dims_weight_g(10, 10, 10.01) == 201      # 200.2 g rounds up


def test_chargeable_weight_and_box():
    small = BOXES[0]
    assert chargeable_weight_g(small, 100) == 600
    assert chargeable_weight_g(small, 900) == 1020
    assert pick_box(2000).name == "S"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        pick_box(10**6)


def test_rates():
    assert shipping_cents("US", 400) == 495
    assert shipping_cents("US", 400, order_total_cents=20_000) == 0
    assert shipping_cents("FR", 1500) == 2495
    with pytest.raises(TooHeavy):
        shipping_cents("FR", 20_000)


def test_carriers():
    assert estimated_delivery("ups", "US", date(2026, 11, 20)) == date(2026, 11, 24)
    assert tracking_link("post", " ab12 ") == "https://track.example/post/AB12"


def test_format_weight():
    assert format_weight(1500) == "1.5 kg"
    assert format_weight(1000) == "1 kg"
    assert format_weight(1234) == "1.23 kg"
    assert format_weight(250, "g") == "250 g"


def test_packing_slip():
    from shopkit.orders.fulfillment import Parcel, packing_slip
    slip = packing_slip(Parcel("o1", 2, [("MUG-1", 3)]), 2500)
    assert slip == "Order o1 - parcel 2\nWeight: 2.5 kg\n  3 x MUG-1"

"""Shipping label content handed to the label printer service."""
from shopkit.customers.addresses import format_address
from shopkit.customers.models import Address
from shopkit.orders.fulfillment import Parcel
from shopkit.shipping.packaging import format_weight


def label_code(sku: str) -> str:
    """Compact code printed under the barcode: uppercase, spaces and dashes removed (scanner-friendly)."""
    return sku.replace(" ", "").replace("-", "").upper()


def label_text(parcel: Parcel, to: Address, parcels_total: int, weight_g: int | None = None) -> str:
    lines = [format_address(to), "", f"Order {parcel.order_id}  parcel {parcel.number}/{parcels_total}"]
    if weight_g is not None:
        unit = "lb" if to.country == "US" else "kg"
        lines.append(f"Weight: {format_weight(weight_g, unit)}")
    lines += [f"{label_code(sku)} x{qty}" for sku, qty in parcel.items]
    return "\n".join(lines)

"""Boxes and chargeable weight. Carriers bill the larger of actual and volumetric weight."""
from dataclasses import dataclass

VOLUMETRIC_DIVISOR = 5000          # cm^3 per kg, the common courier convention


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Box:
    name: str
    length_cm: int
    width_cm: int
    height_cm: int
    tare_g: int

    @property
    def volume_cm3(self) -> int:
        return self.length_cm * self.width_cm * self.height_cm


BOXES = [Box("S", 20, 15, 10, 120), Box("M", 35, 25, 15, 250), Box("L", 50, 40, 30, 480)]


def dims_weight_g(length_cm: float, width_cm: float, height_cm: float) -> int:
    """Volumetric weight in grams for a parcel's outer dimensions (L x W x H / 5000 kg), rounded up
    to the next whole gram."""
    grams = length_cm * width_cm * height_cm / VOLUMETRIC_DIVISOR * 1000
    return int(-(-grams // 1))


def format_weight(grams: int, unit: str = "kg") -> str:
    """Weight for display on labels, slips and the storefront. unit is "kg" (default), "g" or "lb":
    kg drops trailing zeros (1500 -> "1.5 kg"), g is whole grams ("250 g"), lb has two decimals
    (1500 -> "3.31 lb")."""
    if unit == "g":
        return f"{grams} g"
    if unit == "lb":
        return f"{grams / 453.59237:.2f} lb"
    return f"{round(grams / 1000, 2):g} kg"


def chargeable_weight_g(box: Box, contents_g: int) -> int:
    actual = contents_g + box.tare_g
    return max(actual, dims_weight_g(box.length_cm, box.width_cm, box.height_cm))


def pick_box(total_volume_cm3: int) -> Box:
    """Smallest box whose volume holds the items with 20% packing slack."""
    for box in BOXES:
        if box.volume_cm3 * 0.8 >= total_volume_cm3:
            return box
    raise ValueError(f"no box fits {total_volume_cm3} cm3")
